notes:
POC summary & negotiation notes:
- Primary ask: enterprise-grade Dedicated for customer-facing chat + real-time risk scoring (model: open-llama-70b-quant).
- Throughput negotiation is the blocker. Argentum requests a hard minimum throughput guarantee to support peak trading windows.
- Baseline POC (2 x H100 equiv nodes) measured: sustained 18k tokens/sec at 512-token average, 460 concurrent sessions before queuing observed. p50 latency ~95ms, p95 ~420ms at this load.
- Argentum target (negotiated): min_tokens_per_sec (sustained) = 60,000 tokens/sec for 30-minute windows; concurrency cap target = 600 concurrent streams; burst allowance = up to 4x sustained for 120s; acceptable ramp-down window = 300s.
- Redwood proposal (v1): guaranteed 50k tokens/sec sustained (1 hour SLA test), concurrency soft-cap 500 (circuit-breakers above 550), burst policy 3x sustained for 60s, with fallbacks to smaller model variants. Penalty: service credit tied to demonstrated failure to meet min_tokens_sec under accepted test harness.
- Argentum asks for: explicit acceptance test (1-hour sustained run at target with p95 latency < 500ms), observable metrics (token/sec, queue length, per-route latency) exported to their Grafana via read-only Prometheus endpoint, audit logs + KMS for key material.
- Reserved GPU planning: Argentum wants guidance on sizing. Current ask maps to ~8x H100-equivalent GPUs (estimate from SE) with autoscale headroom + burst pool. They prefer fixed-reserve with burst capacity billing model (reserve baseline, pay for burst).
- SLA negotiation points flagged by legal: liability caps for model hallucinations, data residency for training-derived artifacts (they want US-only), retention window for logs (90 days), and clear definition of "sustained" vs "burst" in contract.
- Quote: Redwood provided draft pricing: baseline reserved capacity + burst units; estimated ARR in $200-600k range depending on reserved GPU count and burst credits.
- Direct quote from CTO: "We can't tolerate silent throttling during market opens — need predictable throughput or we build it ourselves."
- Next ops ask: include explicit concurrency throttling behavior in doc (graceful 429s with Retry-After + token-aware queue position).
- Action items: SE to produce final capacity calc + suggested GPU SKU list; AE to iterate SLA language with legal; Solution architect to produce acceptance-test harness (scripts + JMX/Prometheus metrics) by 2026-03-18.
- Acceptance criteria (Argentum): 1) 1-hour sustained run >= agreed min_tokens_sec; 2) p95 latency < 500ms; 3) no hard errors > 0.2% of requests; 4) metrics export and audit logs enabled.
- Notes style: shorthand, captured by AE after 2026-03-05 onsite session.
